# RetailerOS

> Retail management software built specifically for Indian consumer electronics retail — mobile phones, home appliances, air conditioners, refrigerators, televisions, laptops and IT. GST billing, inventory, serial and IMEI tracking, brand scheme reconciliation, service job cards and customer khaata in one system of 26 modules. Every unit is tracked individually, whether it is a handset with an IMEI or an appliance with a serial number. A product of Khosha Systems, built in India.

RetailerOS is used at the shop counter rather than in a back office. It is purpose-built for electronics retail, which distinguishes it from general accounting tools: serial and IMEI chain-of-custody tracking, brand scheme reconciliation across handset, appliance and IT brands, repair job cards and multi-store management are native, not add-ons (a retailer-to-retailer B2B marketplace is coming soon).

## Plans (prices exclude 18% GST; quarterly saves 5%, annual saves 15%)
- Free — ₹0 forever. 50 bills/month, 7 modules, 3 staff logins, 1 store. Unlimited customer and IMEI history.
- Shop — ₹3,999/month. 750 bills/month, 20 of 26 modules, 3 staff logins, 1 store.
- Pro — ₹7,499/month for the first store + ₹3,499/month for each additional store. Two stores (₹10,998/month). Unlimited bills, all 26 modules, 3 staff logins per store.
- Extra stores on Pro — ₹3,499 per store per month, each including 3 staff logins. No cap; there is no separate enterprise plan.

## Add-ons
- Extra store (Pro) ₹3,499/mo · Extra staff login ₹499/mo (only beyond the 3 included per store) · 250-bill pack ₹499
- 500 WhatsApp messages ₹249 · 10 GB storage ₹149/mo · Dedicated WhatsApp number ₹1,499/mo
- Claim recovery, done for you ₹2,499/mo

### Solutions
- [Mobile phone retail](https://retaileros.in/solutions/mobile-phone-retail/): IMEI tracking, Vivo/Samsung/Oppo scheme reconciliation and repairs for mobile shops.
- [Appliance and AC dealers](https://retaileros.in/solutions/appliance-and-ac-dealers/): serial-number tracking, EMI and bank offers, brand schemes and service callouts for AC, refrigerator and TV dealers.
- [Multi-store chains](https://retaileros.in/solutions/multi-store-chains/): one owner login across every store, per-store stock, staff, cash and invoice numbering.
- [Repair and service centres](https://retaileros.in/solutions/repair-and-service-centres/): repair job cards from intake to handover, device history by IMEI or serial.

### Comparisons (dated, sourced)
- [RetailerOS vs Tally](https://retaileros.in/compare/tally-alternative/): Tally is accounting software; IMEI tracking needs a paid add-on. RetailerOS runs the retail counter.
- [RetailerOS vs Vyapar](https://retaileros.in/compare/vyapar-alternative/): Vyapar is low-cost billing that tracks IMEIs. RetailerOS adds scheme reconciliation, repair job cards and multi-store.
- [Moving off paper registers and Excel](https://retaileros.in/compare/paper-register-and-excel/)
- [RetailerOS vs retaileros.ai](https://retaileros.in/compare/retaileros-ai/): separate, unaffiliated companies. retaileros.ai sells US-dollar point-of-sale for general retail.

## Comparisons (added 28 September 2026)
- [RetailerOS vs APX](https://retaileros.in/compare/apx-erp-alternative/): APX ERP runs some of India's largest mobile chains as a custom ERP. RetailerOS is published-price software for single stores and growing chains.
- [RetailerOS vs Marg](https://retaileros.in/compare/marg-erp-alternative/): Marg ERP 9+ is desktop billing and accounting with IMEI tracking. RetailerOS adds brand scheme tracking, repair job cards and cloud multi-store.
- [RetailerOS vs Zoho](https://retaileros.in/compare/zoho-books-inventory-alternative/): Zoho Books and Inventory are strong cloud accounting and stock tools for any business. RetailerOS is built for the electronics counter.

## Modules
- [All 26 modules](https://retaileros.in/modules/): every RetailerOS module and the plan that includes it.
- [Schemes](https://retaileros.in/modules/schemes/): The Schemes module in RetailerOS keeps every brand and bank scheme you are running in one place — what it pays, which products it covers and how long it runs. It tracks your sales against each brand's target and incentive slab as you bill, and every sale made under a scheme becomes a claim you can follow until the brand pays.
- [Automation](https://retaileros.in/modules/automation/): The Automation module sends WhatsApp messages to your customers on a schedule you set. Attach a campaign to a purchase and RetailerOS sends a sequence over the following days — a thank-you, a how-to, a check-in, an accessory offer — and it can send birthday wishes automatically. Every message is logged against the customer.
- [Marketing](https://retaileros.in/modules/marketing/): The Marketing module creates promotional images for your store with AI. Describe what you want — "Diwali offer, 20% off Samsung phones" — and RetailerOS generates the banner or social post, which you can download or share on WhatsApp. Add a product photo and it suggests marketing copy for it.
- [Pre-booking](https://retaileros.in/modules/pre-booking/): The Pre-booking module lets you take advance bookings for upcoming launches. Create a campaign with the product, deposit and dates, share its booking page with customers on WhatsApp, and track every booking as pending or confirmed. When the stock arrives, each booking becomes a sale with the deposit already deducted.
- [Marketplace](https://retaileros.in/modules/marketplace/): The Marketplace module gives your store two new places to sell. Your online store is an e-commerce site for your customers, with listings, orders and shipping run from RetailerOS. The retailer marketplace — coming soon — lets RetailerOS retailers buy and sell stock with each other, so excess and open-box stock finds a buyer.
- [Stores](https://retaileros.in/modules/stores/): The Stores module runs several locations from one RetailerOS account. Each store keeps its own stock, staff, cash register and invoice numbering, and you see all of them — sales, stock and performance — from one owner login. It is part of the Pro plan, and every store includes 3 staff logins.
